author: Jerriy
title: Resize Picture Context menu entries appear twice in context menu

judgment.rationale: The issue remains open and recent October reports confirm duplicate Image Resizer entries, but the live issue is explicitly assigned to Copilot and marked Status-In progress. The earlier duplicate chain terminates here: #25361 was closed as a duplicate of #20255, and #32152 was closed in favor of #25361.
evidence: The latest issue metadata lists Copilot as assignee and Status-In progress.
A reporter confirmed in October 2026 that duplicate entries still occur.
The linked duplicate chain points back to this issue rather than to a separate covering fix.
Current PowerToys context-menu documentation describes dual registration for Image Resizer and says it can create duplicate entries in the expanded Windows 11 menu.
judgment.recommended_action: Leave the active issue with its assigned owner and re-evaluate if ownership is released or the owner requests additional help.

fix_assessment.rationale: A competing fix proposal is not appropriate while the issue is assigned to Copilot and marked in progress; this is an ownership disposition, not a claim that the reported behavior is invalid.
